title: energy_forecast round input
description: Evaluation shape for one round. Instances themselves are drawn inside the referee from the platform's per-round SEED and the pinned/live demand data; the round input only carries the (miner-visible, non-secret) evaluation dimensions.

num_instances.description: Task instances per round (backtest mode only -- live mode always evaluates one instance per tracked Balancing Authority).

deadline_ms.description: Per-/act deadline for the forecaster, enforced by the referee's HTTP client.

mode.description: backtest: instances sampled from already-known pinned history, scored immediately (used for local dev, baseline training, and sigma_round sizing). live: production mode -- instances are the freshest confirmed window per BA with a genuinely unknown target; requires the two-phase lock/resolve extension in PLATFORM_PROPOSAL.md.
